note:
Banner for /collections/skin-repair-renewal. Malcolm chose pdrn-collagen-repair-cream--I-body-and-face-left nbp_pro_01 and flagged that the label on the jar is wrong. It is, in five separate ways, all of them visible only at native pixels.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY WRONG, MEASURED AGAINST THE PRODUCT'S OWN HERO SHOT:
  1. The DNA helix mark sits ABOVE the wordmark as a loose scatter of dots and strokes. On the real jar it sits BESIDE 'Skingenetix' on the same line, as a tight dotted double helix.
  2. The thin vertical rose rule down the left of the text block is absent.
  3. 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' is rendered in black. On the product it is dusty rose - it is the only coloured line on the jar and its whole job is to carry the product's colour.
  4. The ingredient line has collapsed to a lowercase '50ml'. It should read 'PDRN | COLLAGEN | COPPER PEPTIDE | 50ML' in small black capitals.
  5. Invented garbled text runs down BOTH sides of the label - the engine filling the curve of the jar with letter-shaped noise.

NOT A MISSPELLING, WHICH IS WORTH SAYING. 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR' itself is correct on this frame. The sheet made several jars in this library look like they read PORN, and every one checked at native pixels reads PDRN - that is the 760px tile downscale eating the stem of the D. This product has a superseded v1 library named for exactly that fault, so it was checked rather than assumed.

THE FIX. The full label is quoted verbatim with the position and colour of every element, the side-text is negated explicitly, and the helix is described by its placement rather than named - a mark named but not placed is what produced the floating scatter.

COMPOSITION. Jar and subject on the LEFT (measured: the right edge is 554 of 848 rows of lit skin, the left edge is clean backdrop at mean 22.2), so the canvas will extend RIGHT afterwards and the heading will sit right. Generated at 3072x1272 to match the aspect extend-banner-canvas.py is tuned for.

FLUX.2 is barred - legible branding. Luma has refused this subject family all session.

slots.title: Malcolm's frame, composition untouched, label corrected
slots.prompt: Take the first reference photograph and keep the woman exactly as she is: the same pose lying with her head resting to one side, the same face and calm expression, the same hair, the same bare shoulder and neck, the same deep backdrop, the same lighting, and the same framing with the jar held in her hand at the LEFT of the picture. Do not re-pose her, do not re-light her, do not move the hand or the jar, and do not smooth her skin - keep its real pores, fine lines and freckles, with no allover swirl or repeating pattern anywhere. Change ONLY the jar's label, replacing it with the label from the second reference image, reproduced exactly. The jar is a 50ml frosted ROSE-PINK glass cream jar with a wide brushed silver screw lid. Its front label reads, from the top: first a single line containing the Skingenetix DNA double-helix mark in black immediately to the LEFT of the wordmark 'Skingenetix' in bold black, the mark and the word sitting side by side on that one line and the mark no taller than the word. Below that, a thin vertical dusty-rose rule runs down the left of the text block, and to the right of that rule, in this order: 'PDRN COLLAGEN REPAIR' in bold black capitals on ONE line; 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' in bold DUSTY ROSE capitals on ONE line, this being the only coloured line on the jar; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in plain black capitals. Below the text block and centred, 'PDRN | COLLAGEN | COPPER PEPTIDE | 50ML' in small black capitals with thin vertical bars between the words. Those are the only characters anywhere on the jar. The curved sides of the jar carry NO text of any kind - no ingredient list, no small print, no letters wrapping around the glass. Do not add, remove, reorder or restyle any word. The label is turned square to camera, is the plane of focus and the sharpest thing in the picture, every character crisply edged and legible down to the smallest line, and her fingers stay clear of the lettering.
